title: An interior penalty nonconforming finite element method for strain gradient elasticity
summary: An interior penalty nonconforming finite element method is developed for a strain gradient elasticity (SGE) model in arbitrary dimensions, using an $H^1$-nonconforming displacement element built from vector-valued quadratic polynomials enriched by divergence-free face bubbles. Rigorous analysis establishes optimal and robust error estimates with respect to both the Lamé coefficient $λ$ and the size parameter $ι$.
